profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Fortinet
profile.summary:
Utilize skills and knowledge of network security and software methodologies in developing Web and Cloud-based applications. Ensure teamwork and collaboration is incorporated into all processes and projects. Demonstrate adaptability and flexibility in all tasks. Passionate and dependable in solving challenging problems. Proven ability to solve large scale data problem using analytical and software development skills.
I may be reached at email: nelsonnguyent@gmail.com.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on FortiSwitch (FSW). 
- Took the initiative with new features and was proactive in gathering information and implemented new features in FSW GUI.
- Be a team player & a risk taker while collaborating with teams starting from design all the way till implementation and to become a key player in delivering new FSW GUI features
- Worked effectively with team members, seniors, release/dev QA to find root cause, solve problems and deliver new features as a team, became a key resource for FSW GUI related issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer Enterprise Content Management
positions.description:
Worked on IBM Content Manager and Datacap fix pack and major release. Supported Q/A and Build team to meet release milestones.
- Assist in creating end-to-end Bluemix Web application, using Docker, Box API, Datacap, and Cloudant, making Datacap available for Box users.
- Customized and integrated new web-based dashboard for Datacap Web Plugin, using Dojo, Java, and JavaScript, enabling line of business manager to monitor and improve Datacap image platform performance.
- Worked on Datacap 9.0.1 major release, as well as deliverable z/OS toolkit enhancement and DB2 text search, supporting Content Manager Enterprise Edition fix pack 3.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Supported development team in improving latest Cisco Identity Service Engine (ISE) installation time.
- Upgraded Cisco Identity Service Engine (ISE) database to latest Oracle version, using in-memory option (P.O.C), improving ISE query performance from 10 to 98 times faster.
- Created Cassandra cluster, handling heavy writing workload in ISE node (P.O.C).
- Updated and verified ISE inter-node communication diagram, making communication among ISE nodes up-to-date.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Supported Sustaining Team in debugging, fixing, and creating new ISE patch.
- Updated ISE Tomcat to latest version, making Tomcat available to the latest ISE release.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Helped Support Team to design and implement new web portal to handle customer issues worldwide.
- Designed CM Support Web Portal, using WCF 4.0 and SQL 2005 as backend service, enabling auto ticket assignment among support team members.

projects.title: Meter 101
projects.description:
+ Extracted, Transformed and Loaded data using Hive
+ Stored Transformed data on the Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS)
+ Used Cloudera Impala to handle Online Transaction Processing (OLTP)

projects.title: Tacklr
projects.description:
+ Created back-end database using MySQL
+ Deployed Tackler on Amazon EC2 Server using Yii Framework
+ Developed user's module including profile encryption, activation email, password reminder.

skills.name: C, C++, C# (.Net), Java, X++, C-Script
